title: It was possible for an authenticated non-admin user to modify certain data objects without having the appropriate…
description: An authenticated non-admin user in AXIS Camera Station could modify certain data objects without proper permissions, potentially tampering with audit log creation. This vulnerability impacts data integrity but does not affect confidentiality or availability. The issue is tracked as CVE-2026-63287 and has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6.5.
